plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "price endings") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets the specific pricing-psychology literature on .99 endings and left-digit effects that directly informs list-price tests.

queries.query: ("price discount" OR "sales promotion" OR "promotional pricing" OR couponing) AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR branding)
queries.rationale: Catches evidence on whether promotions lift conversion, shift reference prices, or create longer-run downsides for demand and brand.

queries.query: ("reference price" OR "price fairness" OR "internal reference price" OR "price perception") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Focuses on how buyers interpret prices relative to expectations, which is central to premium pricing and promo framing decisions.

queries.query: ("scarcity appeal" OR "limited-time offer" OR "limited quantity" OR "stock scarcity") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Pulls work on countdowns, low-stock messaging, and urgency cues that influence checkout behavior and purchase timing.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "customer review" OR "review valence" OR "review helpfulness") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Captures research on how ratings, reviews, and peer signals affect conversion and product-page performance.

queries.query: ("message framing" OR "gain-loss framing" OR "attribute framing" OR "goal framing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR advertising OR persuasion OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets framing effects in marketing messages that can change response without changing the underlying offer.

queries.query: ("advertising creativity" OR "creative effectiveness" OR "ad creative" OR "advertising appeal") AND (marketing OR advertising OR consumer OR persuasion OR branding)
queries.rationale: Finds studies on which creative features drive attention, persuasion, and sales rather than just brand-theory commentary.

queries.query: ("visual attention" OR "eye tracking" OR "visual salience" OR "gaze pattern") AND (advertising OR marketing OR ecommerce OR packaging OR "web design")
queries.rationale: Surfaces evidence on what people actually look at in ads, packaging, and pages, which is useful for landing-page and creative optimization.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "conversion rate" OR "website conversion" OR "online conversion") AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR retail OR experimentation OR persuasion)
queries.rationale: Catches practical web-conversion research on page design, persuasion elements, and online purchase behavior.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR "default option" OR nudging OR "behavioral nudge") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "behavioral economics" OR retail)
queries.rationale: Targets intervention-style research on defaults and small design changes that can move selection and conversion.

queries.query: ("product name" OR "brand name" OR naming OR "brand linguistics") AND (marketing OR branding OR consumer OR advertising OR linguistics)
queries.rationale: Pulls naming research on phonetics, semantics, and memorability that can inform product-title and brand-name decisions.

queries.query: ("fluency effect" OR "processing fluency" OR "easy-to-pronounce" OR "name fluency") AND (marketing OR consumer OR branding OR advertising OR judgment)
queries.rationale: Targets the specific mechanism by which easier-to-process names and messages can change liking, trust, and choice.

queries.query: ("personalization" OR "personalized offer" OR "targeted promotion" OR "recommendation framing") AND (marketing OR ecommerce OR retail OR consumer OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Covers when tailoring messages or offers improves response versus triggering privacy or fairness concerns.

queries.query: ("consumer attention" OR "banner blindness" OR "ad attention" OR "display advertising") AND (marketing OR advertising OR ecommerce OR consumer OR "digital advertising")
queries.rationale: Looks at whether people notice and process digital ads at all, a key constraint on creative and placement performance.

queries.query: ("promotional framing" OR "percent-off" OR "dollar-off" OR "bonus pack") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR promotion)
queries.rationale: Finds studies comparing how discount formats are perceived, which matters for structuring offers rather than just changing magnitude.

queries.query: ("willingness to pay" OR "purchase intention" OR "purchase likelihood" OR "conversion intention") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR pricing)
queries.rationale: Acts as a recall-safety query for outcome-focused marketing experiments that report the buyer-response metrics this reader cares about.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan emphasizes evidence-heavy levers a growth marketer can actually test: pricing, promotion structure, scarcity, social proof, framing, creative, attention, landing-page conversion, naming, personalization, and nudges. It deliberately skips advertising history, media theory, and broad branding discourse because the profile wants causal or behavioral findings tied to measurable outcomes. I assumed the reader values digital commerce relevance most, so several queries are scoped to ecommerce, retail, and conversion-oriented consumer research rather than general communications scholarship.
